consentTitle: What we will do with your information
consentBody: We use your profile details, including religion, caste, horoscope details and photographs where you choose to give them, to show your profile to other members and to suggest matches. We use your email and mobile number to sign you in, send one-time passcodes and security alerts, and to tell you about matches and messages. We never sell your data and never use it for advertising. You can see, correct, export or erase it at any time, and you can delete your account yourself.
